include: Tick spacing is picked from a set of round steps (such as 1, 2 and 5 times a power of ten) so labelled ticks stay at least a minimum number of screen pixels apart.
Tick positions come from mapping document coordinates to the screen with the viewport's zoom and pan.
The rulers update when the zoom, the pan or the selection changes.
The highlighted extent comes from the selection bounds, with rotation included.
The plan includes tests of the spacing at several zoom levels.
avoid: A fixed tick step in document units, so the labels crowd or spread apart as the zoom changes.
Highlighting the extent of only the first selected layer, or ignoring rotation.
